newsitem.title: USA: US stocks mixed, blue chips widen lead over techs.
newsitem.headline: US stocks mixed, blue chips widen lead over techs.

text.p: The Dow industrials extended their modest gains in afternoon activity on Wednesday in an otherwise listless performance by stocks.

The Dow was up 23 points at 6610 with NYSE advancing and declining issues running about even. The Nasdaq Composite pressed lower, however, shedding nine points to 1204 as a soft technology sector continued to weigh on the index.
"This market does not have the feel of a market of great strength," said Dick Stein, vice president at U.S. Clearing Corp. "There's no real bullish tone out there."
